task.title: A topic fails the links check
task.shortdesc: A link in the migrated page is broken, its navigation differs, or an old URL no longer resolves.

context.p: Cause: Usually a target that is published in DITA but filtered or renamed in the migration.

step.cmd: Read the link and the build named in the report.
Check the target is published in that build and that its ID is kept.
